TEXT:
Judging from the results, it does seem like 
everything will be fine.
If you want to know why, it's because this beach...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]There's no one else here![/font_size]
Completely devoid of people.
Saori... I knew she was rich, but...
I never expected she would own a private beach...
She's like some princess from a manga.

Well, there's no way a bunch of people could see 
her in a swimsuit here, that's for certain.
This could get rid of some of her embarrassment.
But-

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Saori in a swimsuit, huh.
I can't even imagine it.

Even though she's revealed her true self, the only 
"Saori" that comes to my mind is the one in the 
spiral glasses.

Like when she wore the maid outfit with the glasses 
on-

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hahahaha! How is it!? Sexy, no!
So yeah, nothing but that comes to mind.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...Well, once the real thing appears, that will probably 
be overwritten.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...She's really slow.
I'm tired of waiting.

Suddenly, I felt someone's eyes on the back of my 
neck.
Was that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...That girl.
I think I get what's going on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Isn't it about time you come out now?
I directed my voice towards her hiding spot.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Urgh.
Sure enough, Lady Saori appeared in her swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I-I knew it... It's embarrassing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I thought this would happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You could have just put on a jacket.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I can't do that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
We've come all the way to the beach, so if we don't 
swim...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: And besides...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: T-Thou were looking forward to thy swimsuit, right?
It looks like she's started to act like Bajeena, but...
Without those glasses, it's not working out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Haha, yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, are you sure you're okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You were talking about dying just from holding 
hands, and now you're suddenly wearing a 
swimsuit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: He...hehe... I'm about to die right now as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No good then.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
In any case, if I can't handle this much 
embarrassment... I can't... date a gentleman like you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see.
Geez... She really is a hard worker.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: M-More importantly...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: How is it, my swimsuit!

To hide her embarrassment, she asked me with 
great vigor.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Th-That's quite a bold swimsuit there...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...I prepared it just for today though?
Looks like it's my turn to be embarrassed.
Because...
I can't believe she just got into high school.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...Do you have the same measurements as a certain 
Fujiko?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [font_size=33]!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: G-Geez! Just where are you looking!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sorry.
I've clearly chosen the wrong thing to say.

Instead, I should've said something more suitable 
like, "It looks good on you." or, "It's cute."
But you know what? Hear me out.
If you're presented with such a view-
Holy cow! Her breasts are huge!

And if your mind isn't filled with similar thoughts, 
you can't call yourself a man.

The completely embarrassed Saori stood there and 
muttered,

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [font_size=18]...I-It's the same.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
They're the same as a certain Norika-san! A-Are you 
satisfied!
She talks weird when she gets mad.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: R-Right. I see!

It might be that she's angry, but she doesn't look 
that nervous now. So Saori suggested...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Come, let's do our warm-up and go swimming.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You can swim?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Not as well as my sister, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: When it comes to sports, I'm relatively good at it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh...
She does have a great build.

She runs really fast, she's blessed with athletic 
genes indeed.
Possibly... even better than Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Do you have any sports you play in regularly?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: No, I don't have any interest in them.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I only do them as exercise, such as jogging.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm.

Since Saori seems to only like otaku-related stuff, 
this is how I interpreted her answer.

"I may have athletic talents, but... I don't really like it 
so it's meaningless"

She was thinking somewhere along those lines, 
that's my hunch.
What a waste.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: In that case, wanna do something together?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Eh? Do... what exactly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Anything's fine. Tennis, even basketball.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
A variation of a typical date, that should be fine, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hmmm... I'll think about it.

I figured this out recently, but you don't know if 
something is interesting until you try.

Just like my new interest in Otaku stuff, it'll be good 
if Saori could find the fun in something new.
And besides...
Being merry, playing sports together with Saori...
I can already picture her chest dancing around.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: By the way, Kyousuke-san, can you swim?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Not as well as someone from the swimming club, 
but I think I'm decently fast.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Do you want to race then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, sure.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Hehe, things are heating up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Since it's rare for this to happen, wanna make a 
bet?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's fine, but is it over juice or something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Of course not.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Let's see... If I lose, I'll give you a kiss.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wha...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Fufufufu... What's the matter? Your face is all red.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...You little...
That's it, right there.

She's supposed to be super shy and yet, at times, 
she's incredibly bold.

What's with that? Did she contract a split 
personality as a side effect for acting differently?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Alright then...! I'll take that bet.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That's the way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Also, you can't go saying, "I can't, it's too 
embarrassing" afterwards.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: But of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay...! I'm gonna give it my all!!
